releases.name: A Dungeon Is You
releases.summary:
Oh no, you got hit by a truck and died. Fortunately you have been reincarnated as a dungeon core! All you know is what's inside your dungeon domain.

All you want is to grow stronger and expand your dungeon.

A Dungeon Is You is a modern incremental management game.

releases.name: Brand Nacht
releases.summary: Play as a bored and increasingly frustrated firefighter left behind by his crew in this short walking simulator. Explore the detailed rooms of an empty fire station and experience the restless hours in between call outs.

releases.name: Five Nights with Maids
releases.summary: In this survival horror game, play as a night guard watching over a mansion and its maids for five nights. Use lights, shutters, and cameras to spot suspicious activity. Each night grows more intense as the atmosphere shifts and the maids begin to behave strangely. Can you survive till the end?

releases.name: Fire and Water: Spirits of the Forest
releases.summary: Embark on this two-player adventure in a colorful world to forge a strong bond with your friend, partner, or family. Overcome challenging puzzles. Unleash your unique playstyle using the diverse abilities of Fire, Water, and 5 other forest spirits.

releases.name: VHS World '89
releases.summary: A cozy first-person sorting sim set in a 1989 video rental store. All 3,360 VHS tapes have spilled across the floor — pick them up, read the covers, and shelve them by genre. No timers, no pressure: just the quiet satisfaction of putting every last cassette back in its place.

releases.name: Stream Train
releases.summary: Stream Train is a co-op adventure where up to 6 players livestream their trip through the Uncanny Valley. Grow your audience by taunting cryptid creatures, doing dangerous stunts, and pranking your friends. Can you make it through the valley alive?

releases.name: SOLEMNFABLE
releases.summary: Fight and forgive in this QTE based RPG, and travel the Earth and stars with those who matter most. SOLEMNFABLE - A journey of acceptance.

releases.name: Hollenburg, Hell Castle
releases.summary: "Höllenburg: Hell Castle" is an arcade game with video adventure elements, where you must explore a dark and satanic castle to defeat the generals of evil. Collect items, gain experience points, and level up while uncovering hidden secrets.

releases.name: Inkpress
releases.summary: A relaxing puzzle game about pressing blocks. No rush, just satisfying solutions.

releases.name: Hallow
releases.summary: Medieval Wars is a strategy simulation game that is based on actual history from the ancient times to the renaissance. Develop new technologies, advance to new ages, and attack and capture nations around you.If your flag is waved in both East and West, you are victorious!

releases.name: No exceptions
releases.summary: “Rules are absolute. Break them, and you die. No Exceptions.” Escape an abandoned building from the 10th floor in this first-person death game. Each floor has prohibited actions. Break a rule and it’s game over. Don’t run. Don’t stop. Don’t look. Follow the changing rules and escape alive.

releases.name: Punch Rush
releases.summary: Children love puzzles, and the understanding that parts make up a whole is an important part of the early learning stage. In this app, babies and toddlers can simply drag and drop the pieces of various puzzles to make a complete picture. Choose from puzzles that feature scenes of favorite BabyFirst shows like Numbers Around the Globe, Harry the Bunny, Peekaboo and more!  Features:  - Explores hand-eye coordination - Offer easy drag and drop functionality- Showcases favorite characters from the BabyFirst network- Tested by babies and toddlers  About BabyFirst: BabyFirst is the leading TV network made just for babies, toddlers and parents. Developed by educational experts, BabyFirst shows inspire a variety of developmental skills. Get BabyFirst on TV, online and in your mobile app store. Visit www.babyfirsttv.com
